text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"Ow, ow...
Hey now, your skin's turned all red."

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Ah... I've been busy lately, so I haven't run into anyone who gets all fussy about this stuff. Oh well—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"Huh? W-wait! It's so sticky...!
Did I put on too much cream?!"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Wait, between 'beauty essence' and 'skin lotion',
which one's supposed to be serum...!?
Damn these similar Japanese words!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
*sigh*... If those guys were here,
they'd teach me while laughing it off, though.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Unable to see her friends and troubled by rough skin,
such was Tap Dance City's plight.
